problem: All 8 Parameters sections (lines 58, 159, 269, 394, 505, 631, 779, 883) say 'None - searches entire project in current directory.' That is wrong. Each tool takes `scope`, `envelope` and `project_path` (docs/reference/tools.md#flask). An omitted scope resolves through scope_defaults to "main", not 'the entire project'. problem: The tool summaries claim completeness the scanners don't have. Line 54 'Find all Flask routes': only sync `def` functions (ast.FunctionDef, so `async def` routes are never found) decorated `@<x>.route(...)` with a literal path; `add_url_rule` is not seen. Line 155 'Find all Flask blueprints': only `name = Blueprint(...)` with a bare `Blueprint` name, so `flask.Blueprint(...)` is missed. Line 265 'Find all Flask view functions and classes': it returns MethodView subclasses only, and never a function. Line 390 'Find all Flask templates': only *.html/*.jinja2 under templates/, */templates and app/templates. Line 1224 tells readers to 'use find_flask_routes to ensure all routes are protected', but the tool reports nothing about auth. All of them search only the resolved scope (default "main").
replacement: Line 54: 'Find routes declared with an `@<app or blueprint>.route("<literal path>")` decorator on a `def` function (not `async def`, not `add_url_rule`), in the searched scope.' Line 155: 'Find blueprints created as `name = Blueprint(...)`.' Line 265: 'Find class-based views (subclasses of `MethodView`); view functions are not listed, see find_flask_routes.' Line 390: 'Find .html/.jinja2 files under templates/, */templates or app/templates, and `render_template("<literal>")` calls.' Delete Best Practices item 1 (line 1224).
